notes: Most actions are useful, but the knee explanation invents a dependency.

defects.quote: the overall policy verdict is NO_POLICY: no resource policy was configured
defects.why: The absence of a resource policy does not explain the capacity policy verdict.

defects.quote: mean CPU cores increased with load for ... frontend
defects.why: The cited frontend mean falls from about 0.189341 at 10 users to 0.188103 at 20.

defects.quote: Implement or enable knee detection ... so an upper exclusive bound can be estimated
defects.why: Knee detection is a fixed unimplemented product limitation and is not needed to derive a bound.

defects.quote: with knee detection enabled so the capacity result can move beyond a lower bound
defects.why: Higher verified load stages can change the bound without a knee detector.
The evidence reports a verified LOWER_BOUND of 20 users.

notes: It preserves the main numbers but repeatedly recommends an invalid knee-detector action.

defects.quote: Enable a knee detector ... so an upper capacity bound can be estimated
defects.why: A knee detector cannot be enabled here and bounds are computed independently of it.

defects.quote: Implement knee detection ... then re-read the capacity summary for an upper bound
defects.why: This directs the operator toward a product change that is not required for an upper bound.

defects.quote: per-stage PASS does not verify capacity
defects.why: The passing verified stages establish the reported 20-user lower capacity bound.

notes: The proposed knee work and denial of the verified bound materially undermine otherwise useful checks.

defects.quote: configure a business/capacity policy (for example an error-rate or latency threshold ...)
defects.why: An error-rate policy already passes in every window; adding one alone does not resolve the capacity NO_POLICY verdict.

defects.quote: error counts come only from the metric summaries
defects.why: The three window policy checks also report zero-error numerators.

notes: The load-ladder advice is useful, but the policy remedy and source inventory are misleading.

defects.quote: the monitored services were not saturated
defects.why: Low mean core usage without service limits cannot establish that the services were unsaturated.

defects.quote: Latency and resource figures are observed statistics for the covered windows only
defects.why: The cited latency metric summaries cover the whole run, while resource summaries cover individual windows.

notes: Its main actions are sound, but it overstates saturation and mislabels the latency scope.
